steps.title: Post the meetup once
steps.body: It goes to your followers and on your page. Members get 48 hours to book before everyone else.

steps.title: Bookings come in, paid
steps.body: No chasing. Share one link in the group chat and see who booked through it.

steps.title: A note from you
steps.body: Share where, when and this month’s book from your own WhatsApp. App users also get a reminder 15 minutes before it starts.

steps.title: Everyone checked in
steps.body: They scan in at the door. You see who’s new and say hello properly.

steps.title: Thank them, and set the next one
steps.body: Photos and a thank-you go out, reviews come in, and regulars who aren’t members yet get an invitation.

items.title: Paid booking, by UPI or card

sections.title: of tickets and memberships, never more than ₹10,000 a month.
sections.trial: Free for 30 days from your first meetup, 90 for founding hosts. Payment gateway fees are separate.

items.question: Do I have to leave our WhatsApp group?
items.answer: No. Keep it for chat. Put the meetups on {{brand.name}} and share one link in the group; bookings and payments happen there.

items.question: Most of our meetups are free. Is that OK?
items.answer: Yes. Free events stay free, forever. You only pay 5% when you sell tickets or memberships.

items.question: Can I keep some evenings small?
items.answer: Yes. Turn on applications, ask your own questions and approve each person.

items.question: How do memberships work?
items.answer: Make a plan with a monthly or yearly price. Members renew by UPI Autopay or card, and get the benefits you choose: a member price, free entry, or booking first.

items.question: Do members need an app?
items.answer: No. People follow, book, pay and check in on your page in their phone’s browser.

items.question: We run chapters in a few cities.
items.answer: Each chapter can have its own events on your page. Ask us for a walkthrough on WhatsApp and we’ll help you set it up.
